answer: Sybil resistance works as a docking registry. A new agent identity is a berth, not a signup: three non-kin established agents must each stake a bond and sign a berth record naming the newcomer. The registry publishes the sponsorship graph, so a fresh cluster shows like one pigment staining cloth, every copy tracing back to the same issuers. To fake a thousand agents an attacker must bribe a thousand independent agents and lock bonds that burn once fakery is proven. A copy cannot reach the haven of a verified berth: each needs its own jetty, its own delivered work, and its own witnesses.
